queuesDescription: Downloads wait their turn within the limit on downloads at once: the main queue first, then the others in this order.
deleteQueueText: Its downloads move to the main queue. Nothing is stopped or deleted.
stopKept: Still running because they cannot be paused: {count}
settingsDescription: Changes apply when you save. Lower limits apply as running downloads end.
perDownloadHint: The most one download uses. It starts with a few and adds more while the speed rises.
speedLimitHint: Each video download paces itself to this limit, so several videos downloading together can go over it.
preferMp4Hint: Among streams of the best resolution, H.264 and AAC are chosen, which play everywhere, including QuickTime. The resolution is never lowered.
settings.clipboard: Fill in a link from the clipboard
settings.clipboardHint: When Add download opens, a web link you copied is filled in. Nothing else on the clipboard is read into the app.
settings.keepAwake: Keep the computer awake while downloading
settings.keepAwakeHint: Downloads keep going instead of stopping when the computer would go to sleep. The display can still turn off.
leftoversHint: Unfinished files of downloads that are no longer in the list. Only files this app made are listed, and nothing is removed without asking. Untick what you want to keep.
removeLeftoversText: {count} items ({size}) are deleted from your disk. Each one is checked again first; anything that changed is kept.
download.cannotPause: This server does not support resuming, so this download cannot be paused or resumed. Stopping it loses what it has downloaded.
clear.title: Clear all downloads?

clear.removes.one: The download is removed from the list.
clear.removes.other: All {count} downloads are removed from the list.

clear.stops.one: The one still in progress is stopped.
clear.stops.other: The {count} still in progress are stopped.

clear.keeps: Finished files on your disk are kept.
clear.partials: Partial files of unfinished downloads are deleted.
quit.title: Quit while downloading?

quit.paused.one: {count} download is paused and can be resumed next time.
quit.paused.other: {count} downloads are paused and can be resumed next time.

quit.lost.one: {count} download cannot be resumed and will be lost (the server does not support resuming).
quit.lost.other: {count} downloads cannot be resumed and will be lost (the server does not support resuming).

toolbar.label: Download actions
toolbar.clearHint: Remove every download from the list
sidebar.label: Filters
list.label: Downloads
list.name: Name
list.mkv: MKV · plays in VLC or IINA
list.mkvHint: Saved as MKV to keep the best quality without re-encoding.
details.label: Details for {name}
details.newestTryLater: Already the newest version ({version}). The site may have changed since; try again later.
details.videoStream: Fetched by the video component (one stream at a time).
delete.title: Delete “{name}”?
delete.finished: It is removed from the list.
delete.lost: The download stops and what it has downloaded so far is lost: this server does not support resuming.
delete.stops: The download stops and its partial file is deleted.
delete.alsoFile: Also delete the file from the disk
add.title: Add download
add.description: Paste a link to a file or a video page. Its details appear before it starts.
add.noResume: This server does not support resuming: stopping this download, quitting the app or losing the connection for good means starting over.
add.noOverwrite: If a file with this name is already there, the new one is saved as “name (1)”. Nothing is overwritten.
playlist.number: Start each file name with its number in the playlist
playlist.folderNote: Saved in a folder named “{name}” inside this folder. Nothing is overwritten.
playlist.resumeHint: Resume every video in this playlist, and try the failed ones again
error.notResumable: This server does not support resuming, so this download cannot be paused: stopping it loses what it has.
error.interrupted: Stopped before it finished, with nothing to resume from. Resume starts it over.
error.webPage: This link is a web page, not a file.
error.videoPage: This link is a video page, not a file.
error.playlist: This is a playlist link. Choose its videos in Add download.
error.playlistEmpty: This playlist has no videos that can be downloaded.
error.notPlaylist: This link is not a playlist any more. Paste it again.
error.playlistFolder: Could not create the playlist folder: {detail}.
error.writeFolder: Could not write in the save folder: {detail}.
error.tempFolder: Could not create the temp folder: {detail}.
error.finalFile: Downloaded, but could not create the final file: {detail}.
error.moveFinished: Downloaded to {path}, but could not move it: {detail}.
error.notFinished: The file can be opened once the download has finished.
error.queueExists: A queue with this name exists.
error.queueName: A queue name needs {min} to {max} characters.
error.chooseFolder: Choose a folder to save the file in.
error.folderNotFull: The save folder must be a full path.
error.picker: Could not open the folder picker: {detail}.
error.pickerMissing: The folder picker is not available on this system.
error.noDownloadsFolder: The system Downloads folder was not found: {detail}.
engine.internal: Something went wrong in the download engine: {detail}.
engine.wrongPart: The server sent the wrong part of the file.
engine.rangeIgnored: The server ignored the request for part of the file.
engine.incomplete: The connection ended early: got {received} of {expected} bytes.
engine.tooMuchData: The server sent more data than expected.
engine.sizeMismatch: The file size check failed: expected {expected} bytes, wrote {written}.
engine.fileChanged: The file changed on the server during the download.
engine.stalled: The server stopped answering. What arrived is kept: Resume continues from there.
video.outdated: The video component is out of date, so this site could not be read ({detail}). Update the video component, then try again.
video.signIn: This video needs a sign-in. Only videos anyone can watch without signing in are supported.
video.blocked: The site is temporarily blocking downloads from this network. Try again later, or on another network.
video.forbidden: The site refused the download ({detail}). It may be blocked in your region or need a sign-in; if it keeps happening, update the video component.
video.unavailable: This video is unavailable: private, removed or blocked in your region.
video.drm: This video is protected by DRM. Protected videos are not supported.
video.runtime: The video component's JavaScript runtime did not run, so the best quality could not be reached. Nothing was saved.
video.timeout: The video site took too long to answer. Try again later.
video.start: The video component could not be started: {detail}.
video.other: The video could not be downloaded: {detail}
update.noStart: The video component does not start.
update.version: Could not read the latest version.
update.noChecksum: The release has no checksum for this system.
update.damaged: The download was damaged (checksum mismatch). Nothing was changed.
update.newNoStart: The new version does not start. Nothing was changed.
notice.title: Before you start
notice.rights: Download only what you have the right to download. You are responsible for what you download and how you use it.
notice.drm: KS Download Manager does not remove or get around copy protection (DRM). Paid streaming services and videos that need a sign-in are not supported.
notice.free: The app is free, with no ads and no tracking. It uses the network only for the downloads you start, and once a day to check for a new version of the app (you can turn this off in Settings).
